title: Kaidon Essentials
description: A structured essentials plugin built for performance. Core systems with Vault and PlaceholderAPI dependencies, focused on flexibility and integration.
body:
# KaidonEssentials **Modular essentials plugin for Minecraft servers.** Economy · Warps · Homes · Teleport · Chat · Administration · Utilities ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.1-C9941A?style=flat-square) ![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-1.21%2B-7c3aed?style=flat-square) ![Folia](https://img.shields.io/badge/Folia-supported-4ade80?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-All%20Rights%20Reserved-555?style=flat-square)
Support for versions below 1.21 has been discontinued as of version 1.0.1.
--- ## Overview KaidonEssentials is a clean, modular and performant essentials plugin designed for servers that want a solid foundation without the bloat. Every system is independent, well-structured and integrates seamlessly with **Vault** and **PlaceholderAPI**. Built to be reliable, easy to configure, and ready to use out of the box. --- ## Systems **Economy** Vault-integrated currency system. Players can check balances, transfer money between each other, and admins have full control over the economy. **Warps** Interactive GUI for public teleport points. Admins can create, edit and delete warps through a dedicated admin panel — no commands needed for players. **Homes** Each player manages their own personal teleport points. Set, visit and delete homes freely from anywhere in the world. **Teleport** TPA system with accept and deny, so players can request teleports safely. Includes server spawn management for admins. **Chat** Local and global chat with configurable cooldown, admin spy mode, mute system, chat clear and highlighted server announcements. Color support via permission. **Administration** Freeze players, inspect inventories, control movement speed and reload the plugin on the fly — all without restarting the server. **Utilities** Quality of life commands for everyday gameplay: personal EnderChest access anywhere, a virtual trash bin and permanent night vision toggle. --- ## Compatibility | Platform | Tested Versions | |---|---| | Spigot | 1.21+ | | Paper | 1.21+ | | Purpur | 1.21+ | | Pufferfish | 1.21+ | | Folia | 1.21+ | --- ## Requirements - [**Vault**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) — required for economy features - [**PlaceholderAPI**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) — required for placeholders Both are **optional**. The plugin loads without them, but related features will be unavailable. --- ## Installation 1. Download the `.jar` from the **Files** tab above 2. Place it inside your server's `/plugins` folder 3. Restart the server 4. Configure at `plugins/KaidonEssentials/config.yml` --- ## PlaceholderAPI | Placeholder | Description | |---|---| | `%kaidon_balance%` | Player's current balance, formatted with K / M / B / T suffixes | --- ## Links [Website](https://kaidon.tech) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/EvV7BdVaAU) · [GitHub](https://github.com) · [Patreon](https://patreon.com) ---
Made with care by Radu · Kaidon Studios
